newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: French stick with EMU timetable-Ireland's Quinn.
newsitem.headline: French stick with EMU timetable-Ireland's Quinn.

text.p: Irish Finance Minister Ruairi Quinn said on Sunday the new French government had committed itself at a finance ministers' meeting to sticking to the current date for economic and monetary union (EMU).
He said the underlying message from the meeting was that EMU was on target.
"The French confirmed their position that they are for the date and the euro," Quinn said as he left a dinner at which the single currency was discussed.
He said: "The clear underlying message tonight was that EMU was on target. The momentum towards a single currency was being maintained."
Italian Finance Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi also said countries had underlined their desire to see economic and monetary union (EMU) start on time.
"We confirmed the committment of each country to respect the treaty," he said.
